note: Lolo NF campground in the Rock Creek drainage, adjacent to Rock Creek (blue-ribbon trout stream) among ponderosa pine and Douglas-fir: I-90 exit 126 (20 mi east of Missoula), then 17 mi south on Rock Creek Road #102. Access is via a narrow, rough gravel road; larger rigs cautioned but most sources cite 30-32 ft capacity. --Claude
